name: Advanced Finite Element Method
description: Revision of basic concepts of FEM, linear finite element formulation of plate elements, introduction to geometric and material nonlinearities, Lagrangian and Eulerian description of motion, strain and stress measures: Green-Lagrange or Green strain tensor, Almansi-Hamel or Eulerian strain tensor, Cauchy stress tensor, first Piola-Kirchhoff stress tensor, second Piola-Kirchhoff stress tensor, energetically-conjugate stresses and strains. Hyperelasticity, linear viscoelasticity, nonlinear finite element formulation: truss, beam, plate and shell elements. Linear/nonlinear dynamics, solution techniques: Newton-Raphson method, path continuation, shooting technique. Finite element formulation involving contact.
